Synthetic PiX events exports with the column layout of the owner's
`PiX_MEX_ActiveCartels_Events_<date>.csv` files (ADR 0010). Every row, place, handle and
status ID here is invented; no PiX content is committed. Status IDs are valid X snowflakes
for known times. Variants covered: one post on two rows (two mapped locations), a
"Government / Military Operations" row (dropped), a row with no X URL (dropped), a Spanish
row with no event date and a twitter.com URL with a query string, and a later export that
overlaps the first (only the new post is added).
